purpose: Day-ahead hourly forecasting of all-India electricity demand using archived weather forecasts, evaluated on a held-out period.

data_coverage.refresh_note: This is a fixed historical research dataset covering 2021-09-01 to 2023-12-31. It is not a live feed and does not update.

kpis.label: Better than same-hour-yesterday
kpis.detail: Reduction in MAE against the naive 24-hour persistence baseline

kpis.label: Gain from weather features
kpis.detail: MAE reduction against the identical model without weather inputs

kpis.label: Daily peak error
kpis.detail: 1.65% of peak; peak hour correct within 1 h on 77% of days

forecast_convention: Day-ahead: every hour of day D is predicted from information available at 09:00 IST on day D-1. Weather inputs are archived day-ahead forecasts, never observations.
